Chase M.

Becky G.

Mornee is an alarm clock that will not turn off until you are actually up.

Pick what it takes to silence it: solve a problem, remember a pattern, walk, shake the phone — or do push-ups, sit-ups, squats or jumping jacks while the camera counts your repetitions.

WHY THE COUNTING IS DIFFERENT

Most rep counters watch how far you travel on screen. Move the phone further away, or don't go all the way down, and they simply stop counting — while you are doing the work.

Mornee measures the angle of your joints instead. Angles do not care how far away the phone is or how you are framed. It also learns the range of motion you are actually producing, so shallow repetitions count, and so does the eighth one when you are tired and going less deep than the first.

YOU ARE NEVER TRAPPED

Detection can fail. A dark room, a duvet, a hopeless camera angle. When it does, Mornee helps instead of going silent: first advice about what to change, then a way to count by hand, and finally an unconditional exit.

No alarm app should hold your morning hostage. Including this one.

WHAT IS INSIDE

• Nine missions across three kinds — think, move, exercise
• Four camera exercises: push-ups, sit-ups, squats, jumping jacks
• Sunrise alarm that brightens the screen while it rings
• Streaks and wake-up history, so you can see whether it is working
• Bedtime reminders
• Seven languages: English, Russian, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Portuguese

NO ACCOUNT. NO ADS.

There is no sign-up. We never ask for your name, email or phone number, and there is no server holding your data. Your alarms and history live on your device and sync through your own iCloud if you use it.

The camera runs entirely on your phone using Apple's on-device Vision framework. No photo or video is ever saved or sent anywhere. We receive the count, never the pictures it came from.

WHAT IT COSTS

Mornee is one subscription, and it is the whole app: setting alarms, all nine missions, the sunrise alarm, hard difficulty, full wake-up history with CSV export and bedtime reminders. There is no advertising and nothing else to buy.

• Yearly — US$24.99, starting with 7 days free

An alarm you set while subscribed keeps working if the subscription lapses. It still rings, and it can still be turned off. Silencing an alarm is never something you have to pay for.

ONE HONEST WARNING

Whether an alarm rings depends on iOS, not only on us — battery, Focus settings, system updates. If missing a wake-up would be serious, set a second alarm in the built-in Clock app too. We would rather say this than have you find out.

results.description:
Wake up more naturally with your wake-up light based on your smart HomeKit lights, and improve your morning routine with Wake Up Light.

Are you tired in the morning? Does your body feel like it doesn't want to get up? Create an artificial dawn with Wake Up Light, so getting up in the morning feels easier and more natural. Built for use with HomeKit-enabled lights, now it’s easy to add a wake-up light alarm to the Apple Home app.

Say you want to wake up at 8:00 a.m. Use Wake Up Light to schedule your bed light to turn on at 7:30 am with its minimum brightness in a dark reddish color. Your light will then gradually increase its brightness and change its color to daylight white until it reaches its full brightness at 8:00 a.m. Got smart blinds? Let them gradually open 20 minutes before your wake-up time. Coffee machine plugged into a smart outlet? Let it turn on 15 minutes before your alarm goes off.

Set a light alarm that starts your day before your desired wake-up time (a recommended duration is something between 30 and 60 minutes). Your light brightens to its maximum intensity by the time you’ve set it, shifting from dim, warm red to bright and cold white after its light-up duration. The brighter the light, the better the effect will be on your body. The goal is to put you into a lighter sleep so that you awaken easier.

FEATURES
– Alarms that turn on lights and change colors as they brighten
– Support for all HomeKit-enabled lights, blinds and outlets
– Alarms are shared with everyone who has access to the same home
– There is no need to keep your iPhone connected (or even on)
– Set the days your wake-up light should wake you
– Combine lightbulbs, power outlets, and smart blinds
– Shortcuts and Siri support to activate, reschedule and deactivate your alarms
– Create multiple wake-up lights and control multiple accessories per alarm
– Preview your wake-up light

Wake Up Light lets you easily create wake-up lights that fit your needs. Just select your light and preferred wake-up time, and Wake Up Light will create HomeKit automation for you, turning your lights on gradually over time.

Adjust the duration of the brightening phase (between 30 and 60 minutes is recommended) and choose the brightness your lights should reach. Your light then brightens to its maximum intensity by the time you have chosen, shifting from dim, warm red to bright and cold white after its light-up duration (if supported by the light bulb).

Add multiple wake-up lights to your weekly schedule. Control different lights with their own custom time, duration and brightness. Everyone in the same house can control the wake-up lights, too – thanks to HomeKit.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

A wake-up light alarm clock brings you slowly into shallower states of sleep by gradually increasing the brightness in your room. The light travels through your closed eyelids, notifying your body the same way as a natural sunrise. This gradual transition from deeper to shallower states of sleep has been found to wake you more naturally and boost your mood, energy and productivity for the whole day.

Let your lights brighten your morning.

• The iPad/iPhone/iPod has to be connected to the same network of your computer

• Wake on LAN requisites
• The network must be reachable via internet

Mac OSX.

• WakeUp Server (tommasomadonia.com/wakeup/server/)
• Java 7+
Linux: (require manual configuration)
• SSH server
• Manual configuration of sleep/shutdown SSH commands


Note: To remotely power on a computer when turned off often requires enabling "Wake on LAN" in BIOS. Mac OSX only support "Wake on LAN" and "Wake over internet" when sleeping.

Your alarm doesn't just beep. It calls you — and keeps talking until you have proven you're awake.

Made for heavy sleepers and chronic snoozers. When WakeYa rings, an AI voice starts a conversation: it can greet you by name, it asks you something your brain has to wake up to answer, and a mumbled "okay" won't get you out. Try every feature free for 7 days — no card, no login.

WHY A VOICE WORKS
A tone is a sound you have learned to sleep through. A voice asking what 7 × 8 is, or what you're getting up for, is a problem you have to be awake to solve.

FOUR CALLERS
• The Skeptic — dry, unhurried, wants proof
• Gentle Coach — warm, patient, never harsh
• Drill Sergeant — loud, and zero negotiation
• The Commentator — your wake-up, commentated live like a cup final
Play each caller's voice before you choose, or let WakeYa surprise you with a different one every morning.

HOW YOU PROVE IT
Choose the wake-up test yourself, or let the caller surprise you: solve a small math problem out loud, repeat a phrase word for word, count backwards in threes or sevens, say what you're getting up for, or hold three words through the whole call and give them back at the end.

THREE DIFFICULTY LEVELS
Gentle gives you three snoozes. Standard gives you one. Relentless gives you none — and makes you wait the longest before the app will even let you give up.

THE GET-UP PROOF
Five or ten minutes after the alarm — you choose, or switch it off — WakeYa comes back and checks that you stayed up. Run a tap and let your phone hear it (the listening happens on the device, offline), or solve a math problem on the number pad. If your phone has already counted you walking around, it stays quiet. Talking your way out of a call is not the same as being out of bed.

QUIET WAKE-UP
Sharing a room? Wake to a soft tone and vibration instead of a voice. The proof is your only way out, and if it hasn't come within five minutes, the alarm gets loud.

BUILT SO IT ALWAYS RINGS
If the network, the AI or anything on our side fails, WakeYa falls back to a classic alarm tone. That rule comes first; everything else is built around it.

WAKE PROFILES
Work, weekend, holiday, Ramadan — each with its own alarms, caller and rules. Switch once, everything follows.

RISE GENTLY IF YOU WANT
An optional soft volume ramp over 30 seconds to 2 minutes, so you're eased awake instead of launched out of bed.

FAJR PRAYER MODE
WakeYa follows your local Fajr time, recalculated daily, with an optional offset for suhoor. Pick your city from a built-in list of 31,000 or type in coordinates — there is no location permission, and your location never leaves your phone. Four respectful Fajr callers, from gentle to strict: never mocking, and the AI never recites religious texts. Quiet reminders for all five daily prayers, a month view of the times, and the Hijri date on your home screen. There is no recorded adhan — WakeYa is the voice that keeps going until you are actually up for it.

ALSO IN THE APP
Bedside clock mode for the nightstand, timers, a stopwatch, one-off events, repeating habit reminders, and 13 themes.

76 LANGUAGES
The app speaks 76 languages, and the live call 97.

PRIVACY IS THE PRODUCT
No account. No sign-up. No ad tracking, no analytics SDK, no profile. There is no database with your name in it, because there is no database. Your wake-up history is stored on your phone, not on our servers.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Everything is free for 7 days. After that, WakeYa stays a complete alarm clock for free: your alarms, the get-up proof, profiles, prayer times and tools all stay, and your caller's voice reads pre-recorded lines. Premium unlocks the live AI: it knows your name, knows how your recent mornings went, and actually talks back. Premium includes 3 live wake-up calls a day (snoozes included), up to 5 minutes each; beyond that, the recorded voice takes over.

results.description:
For people every other alarm has failed.

Rooster is built on Apple's own alarm engine, the same system framework the iPhone's own Clock app uses. That means it rings through the Silent switch, Do Not Disturb, and every Focus mode. Every time. With the app closed. After a restart. At full volume, even when your ringer is at zero.

THE ALARM IS FREE. FOREVER.
No forced subscription to set or stop an alarm. No ads. No account. Repeat schedules, custom labels, snooze rules you control, a nap timer for quick recharges, and a one tap alarm test that proves your phone will ring.

A SNOOZE CAN NEVER DISMISS.
Snooze and stop live at opposite ends of the screen, and a snooze always rings again. That's enforced by the system, not by a promise.

PRO: THE PART THAT GETS YOU OUT OF BED.
Stack up to three missions that must be completed before the alarm stays quiet:
• Math: three difficulty levels
• Steps: walk it off, counted by your phone
• Photo match: photograph your bathroom sink to prove you're up
• Scan: the barcode on your toothpaste
• NFC tag: stick one across the room; works in the dark
• Shake: the gentle one
• Typing: copy the wake phrase, letter by letter, or set your own
• Memory: the tiles flash, you tap them back
• Pushups: the front camera counts your reps
• Squats: stand back, the camera counts every rep
• Item hunt: Rooster names something in your home, you go find it. A new target every wake, zero setup

Pro also brings twelve bundled alarm sounds with Shuffle so your brain never learns one tune, escalation that rings louder every round, and your own alarm sounds.

EVERY MISSION HAS AN ESCAPE HATCH.
Hold ten seconds, type "I give up", and the alarm stops. It always works, even with a broken camera. Rooster makes waking effortful, never impossible.

WAKE CHECK.
Dismissed the alarm and gone back to sleep? Five minutes later Rooster asks "Still up?" If you don't answer, it rings once more. Part of Pro, and on from the start for every new alarm you create with Pro.

PRIVATE BY ARCHITECTURE.
Mission photos are compared on your phone and never uploaded. There is no account, no ads, and no tracking. What leaves your phone is crash reports and usage signals under random IDs, never your alarms or photos.

HONEST PRICING.
A yearly plan with a week free to test everything, plus one simple alternative. Every price shows the full amount you pay, right on the screen. No weekly tricks, no surprise tiers.

SCHEDULES THAT MATCH REAL LIFE.
Skip picked dates on the calendar so the holidays stay silent. Pause everything until the day you fly home, and alarms come back on their own. Set a one time alarm on a future date for the appointment you cannot miss. All free.

Rooster is for heavy sleepers, deep sleepers, shift workers, and everyone who currently sets fifteen alarms to survive one morning. Replace them with one that cannot fail.

Privacy Policy: https://wakerooster.com/privacy/

Snoozed is the alarm that holds you accountable.

Most alarms are easy to ignore. Snoozed changes that. Set a pledge, go to sleep, and wake up knowing there’s something on the line. If you get up and prove you’re awake, you keep your pledge. If you don’t, you forfeit it.

It’s simple. It works.


HOW IT WORKS

1. Set your alarm
    Choose your wake-up time, snooze rules, and proof settings (bed, toothbrush, pet, or the sky).
2. Add a pledge
    Choose an amount and preload your pledge balance in the app.
3. Prove you’re awake

4. Keep or forfeit

BUILT FOR REAL CHANGE

Snoozed isn’t about punishment — it’s about commitment. By putting a pledge behind your alarm, you create a reason to get out of bed that actually works.

• Break the snoozing habit

FEATURES

CLEAR AND SIMPLE

Your pledge balance is preloaded in the app using in-app purchases. Funds are added upfront and used within the app. Nothing is charged after your alarm.

Snoozed is designed to be simple, transparent, and effective.

Stop relying on willpower alone.
Wake up, stay consistent, and take control of your mornings with Snoozed.

results.description:
Ryze is an alarm clock that will not turn off until you have proved you are out of bed.

No snooze button. No slide to dismiss. The alarm rings, you get a mission, and the ringing stops when the mission is done.

WHY IT WORKS
Sleep inertia is strongest in the minute right after the alarm — which is exactly the minute you use to decide whether to get up. Ryze takes that decision away. By the time the mission is finished you are standing up, your heart rate is up, and going back to bed has stopped being an option you are seriously considering.

TEN MISSIONS
• Push-ups, sit-ups, jumping jacks — recorded and checked by the camera
• Photograph your empty bed — proof you actually left it
• Find an item — Ryze names something and you go and photograph it
• Photograph the sky, or step outside and touch grass — daylight, the strongest signal your body clock has
• Read a Bible verse or your own affirmation out loud — Ryze listens
• Solve three quick math problems

IT RINGS EVEN ON SILENT
Ryze rings through the alarm system built into iOS, so it sounds even with the phone on silent and a Focus on.

IT DOES NOT GIVE UP
Slide to stop and you get quiet, not forgiveness. Ryze rings again until the mission is finished.

EVERYTHING IS CHECKED ON YOUR IPHONE
Photos and clips are checked on the device and deleted immediately. Nothing is uploaded, stored or shared, and we never see them. Read-aloud missions use Apple's speech recognition, on-device wherever the device supports it. Missions that need no camera and no microphone are always available.

STREAKS THAT SURVIVE A REAL LIFE
Every morning you finish adds a day. Keep going and you earn rest days — mornings you have decided to sleep in, which your streak carries straight over. Sixteen badges mark the way from your first morning to a full year.

BEDTIME APP LOCK
Optional. Ryze can use Screen Time to close the apps that keep you up during the wind-down hours you choose, and open them again after your alarm. Ryze never sees which apps you use — iOS does the blocking.

SIGN IN TO KEEP IT
Sign in with Apple or Google and your streak, badges and alarms come back if you change phones.

SUBSCRIPTION
Ryze is a subscription. A free trial is offered to new subscribers where available. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and can be managed in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

results.description:
Turning it off isn't waking up.

You set five alarms. You killed all five and don't remember doing it. The person who decides to get up early at 11 pm is never the person who makes the decision at 6 am — and the 6 am one always wins.

EarlyUp takes away the 6 am one's authority.

THE ALARM DOESN'T NEGOTIATE
There is no snooze button — not hidden, not built. And silencing the alert doesn't end the morning: it drops you into your mission, and the ringing comes back until that mission is done. Half-asleep, you can't finish one by accident.

PICK WHAT IT MAKES YOU DO
• Math — solve your way to silence
• Memory — play back the pattern
• Tap Rush — beat the clock with your eyes open
• Steps — the ringing stops when you're actually walking
• Push-ups — counted by the camera, with no preview on screen
• Photo Hunt — find real objects around you and scan them

Three difficulty levels, so you can set it for the version of you that answers at 6am — and raise it when that person gets sharper.

IT RINGS WHEN IT MATTERS
On iOS 26 and later, EarlyUp schedules through Apple's AlarmKit: your alarm goes off on time with the app closed, the phone locked and the ringer off. On earlier versions it keeps itself alive in the background with a notification chain behind it. Stopping the alert brings you straight to your mission.

YOUR PHONE STAYS SHUT UNTIL YOU'RE UP
App Lock closes the apps you reach for in bed during a window you choose. It runs on Apple's Screen Time — you pick the apps, iOS enforces it, and EarlyUp never sees what you use.

PROVE IT — DON'T CLAIM IT
After the mission, hold to record your wake-up. Do it before your target time plus a 10-minute grace and the day counts. Miss the window and it doesn't, even if you were technically awake. You can also record early, any time in the four hours before the alarm.

A STREAK YOU ACTUALLY EARNED
A calendar of every morning you won, every one you lost, and the run you're on. Nothing here is self-reported. Rest days keep a streak alive; missed mornings don't.

WIND DOWN THE NIGHT BEFORE
An optional bedtime reminder and a dimmed wind-down screen, because 6am is decided at midnight.

BUILT SO YOU CAN'T CHEAT IT
• Inside four hours of your goal, the goal locks — no moving it in a moment of weakness
• Backup alerts for the nights iOS gets stubborn
• Follow-up rings if you walk away mid-mission

PRIVACY
No account. No sign-up. Your steps, your camera frames and your app list stay on your phone — they are read while a mission runs and never stored or sent anywhere. There is no marketing notification anywhere in this app.

EarlyUp Plus is a subscription with weekly, monthly, and yearly options, plus a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. UpMode isn't another alarm clock. It's a system that gets you out of bed.

Most alarms are easy to ignore: one tap and you're back asleep. UpMode keeps ringing
until you've completed a morning mission — something you can only do once you're
actually up.

PICK YOUR MISSION
• Solve a maths puzzle
• Do squats or jumping jacks — counted by your camera, on your phone
• Walk 30 steps
• Scan a code you've stuck in the kitchen
• Photograph your bathroom, or your made bed
• Memorise a pattern, or type a sentence
Chain up to three missions per alarm for the mornings that need it.

AN ALARM THAT MEANS IT
UpMode rings through the silent switch and Do Not Disturb. Opening a mission doesn't
stop the sound — finishing it does. If you swipe the alarm away and drift off, a second
ring comes for you five minutes later.

BUILD THE HABIT
Every won morning extends your streak. A Morning Card celebrates each one with a line
written for you and your goal. Your stats show when you actually got up versus when
you meant to — the number every other alarm hides from you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Camera missions run entirely on your phone. No video, no frames, nothing uploaded. No
account required.

UpMode needs iOS 26.1 or later — it's built on Apple's AlarmKit, the only way an app
can ring reliably through silent mode.

results.description:
A morning smile changes your whole day.

SmileAlarm is a fun little alarm clock that stops when you smile. When your alarm goes off, tap "Stop with Smile." Your front camera activates, detects your genuine smile, and turns off the alarm.

Start your day with a smile, and make it a great one.

FEATURES

-- Stop Your Alarm with a Smile
Using your front camera and advanced face tracking, SmileAlarm detects a genuine smile by analyzing both the corners of your mouth and the muscles around your eyes. No fake smiles allowed — wake up with a real one.

-- Smile Score
Every time you stop your alarm, your smile is scored out of 100 points based on mouth and eye expressiveness. Track the quality of your morning smile.

-- Smile Calendar
Days you stopped the alarm with a smile are recorded on a calendar with colors. Darker colors mean higher smile scores. Build your streak and keep the calendar colorful.

-- Streaks
See how many consecutive days you have stopped your alarm with a smile. The desire to keep your streak alive will motivate you every morning.

-- Smile Log
Review your past smile records at a glance. Look back at scores, dates, and your progress over time.

-- Smile Photos
A photo is automatically captured the moment your smile is confirmed. The free plan lets you look back at the latest 3.

-- Repeat & Snooze
Set alarms to repeat on specific days of the week with built-in snooze. With snooze turned on, only a genuine smile fully stops the alarm; sliding to dismiss brings it back after the interval you set.

-- System-Level Alarm
SmileAlarm delivers a full-screen alarm on your lock screen. It sounds through Silent Mode and Focus Mode so you never miss a wake-up.

SMILE ALARM PRO

Upgrade to Pro for an enhanced experience:
- Ad-free experience — remove all banner and native ads
- Unlimited smile photos — the free plan keeps the latest 3, Pro keeps every one
- Smile difficulty settings — choose from Normal, Hard, or Ultra Hard (free is fixed to Normal)

Monthly and yearly plans are available.

PRIVACY

SmileAlarm respects your privacy.

- All face detection is processed entirely on your device
- No facial data is ever sent to external servers
- Smile photos and logs are automatically backed up to iCloud, so your data is safe even if you reinstall the app
- Your iCloud data is private and accessible only by you
- No ads during core experience (alarm, smile detection, score display)
- Anonymous usage data and crash logs are collected to improve the app (no personally identifiable information is included)

REQUIREMENTS

- iOS 26.1 or later
- iPhone with TrueDepth camera (iPhone X or later; iPhone SE models are not supported)
- Camera access permission required

results.description:
You know what you have to do. You write it down. And you don't do it.
It's not a lack of organization: it's too many options and no set moment to start.
WakeUp fixes both: two tasks a day and an alarm that won't stop until you get going.

YOUR DAY WITH WAKEUP

10:30 pm. The night alarm rings. It won't stop until you choose tomorrow's two tasks. It takes a minute and you go to bed with the day already decided.

6:40 am. The morning alarm rings. It won't stop until you solve a mission: memory, math, a photo, shaking your phone or scanning a barcode. By the time it's off, you're actually awake. There is no snooze.

During the day you only see two tasks. Hit Start, the countdown begins, and everything else stays locked until you're done. With two options you don't hesitate. With thirty, you never start.

Complete both and you add a day to your streak. That's it.

WHAT IF I MISS A DAY?

If the night comes with a task undone, your streak resets to zero. It stings, and that's why it works. But your record is always saved, and after 30 days in a row you earn a shield that saves you on a bad day. The net is there to catch you, not to live in.

WHAT WAKEUP DOESN'T DO

It won't let you add forty tasks for today.
It won't send you motivational quotes.
It has no snooze button.
It doesn't ask for willpower: the alarm makes you open it.

WHAT IT DOES HAVE

Kanban and calendar to keep everything else and give it a date. The long list doesn't go away; it just stops getting in the way.
Missions to stop the alarm. A countdown per task. Streaks, shields and badges. Sleep stats.

WHY IT WORKS

Deciding tonight what you'll do tomorrow multiplies the odds you'll do it (Gollwitzer, 1999). The fewer the options, the more you act (Iyengar & Lepper, 2000). Writing down pending tasks before bed helps you fall asleep faster (Scullin, 2018). Losing hurts more than winning feels good, which is why a streak moves you more than any reward (Kahneman & Tversky, 1979).

WHO IT'S FOR

For people who set three alarms and dismiss them all. For people whose list is full and never opened. For people who perform under pressure and freeze without it. If you've tried fourteen productivity apps and none lasted a week, it's not you: they were built for a different brain.

Plan at night. Wake up with the mission. Do two things. Repeat.
